headline: Foreign home purchases in Thailand rebound 20%! Chinese buyers keep declining; this data undermines a long-circulating claim
summary: Foreign purchases of homes in Thailand rebounded 20%, according to the reported data, while Chinese buyers continued to decline. The report challenges a long-circulating claim about foreign buying.
why: Foreign property demand affects Thailand's residential real estate market and the developers and lenders that serve it.

backfill_provenance.description_from: publisher page metadata, translated to English by Claude

original_headline: 外国人泰国购房反弹了20%！中国买家持续下降，这组数据，让一个流传已久的说法站不住脚
